title: 1.2.1 offline en→zh decoding-variant comparison (development set)

dataset.declaration: Fixed development set authored while implementing the 1.2.1 decoding changes. It is not a random held-out corpus and NOT an accuracy benchmark or generalization claim; chrF is measured against one human reference wording per sentence.

decoding.lengthNormalization: score / len^alpha at final selection (beam variants)
decoding.repetitionPenalty: HuggingFace-style divide/multiply on logits of generated tokens
decoding.earlyEosGuard: EOS masked until minEosTokens output tokens

postprocess.note: Same normalization is implemented in OfflineTranslator.kt: collapse whitespace, drop spaces around CJK, ASCII→full-width punctuation only next to CJK, add a final full stop, merge blank lines. Digits and Latin/proper names are never rewritten.
postprocess.digitPreservedCheck: all digit sequences in the source appear in the output (clock values may be re-punctuated, e.g. 9:30 -> 9时30分)

cases.source: Before the company signs the agreement, the legal department must review every clause, confirm that the payment schedule matches the approved budget, verify that the insurance requirements are acceptable, and check whether the termination provisions allow either party to withdraw without a penalty during the first year, because the board will not approve a contract that could expose the organization to unexpected liabilities or make it impossible to change suppliers if the service quality declines.

limitations: Development set, not an accuracy benchmark: sentences were authored while developing these changes.
chrF against one human reference wording measures similarity, not semantic correctness.
The frozen int8 model still mistranslates idioms, legal terms and some multi-word terms; decoding changes do not fix modelling errors.
macOS onnxruntime CPU timings are not Android/tablet timings.
No variant is allowed to override model output with hard-coded sentence translations.
